title: The Oldest Tree on Earth Is Hiding

beats.narration: High in California's White Mountains grows the oldest living tree on Earth — and it almost looks dead.
It's a Great Basin bristlecone pine — about 4,850 years old. Its name is Methuselah.
It sprouted around 2832 BC — a seedling centuries before the Great Pyramid was built.
When the Egyptians raised that pyramid, Methuselah was already 270 years old.
It survives on a single strip of living bark. Most of the tree is already dead — one thin line keeps it alive.
In 1964, a researcher cut down another bristlecone — then counted nearly five thousand rings. The oldest tree ever found, destroyed in minutes.
Methuselah still stands. Its exact location stays secret. The oldest tree on Earth survives because it stays hidden.
